step1_analysis.circuit_type: Bias Network and Amplifier Stage (VCO Sub-circuit)
step1_analysis.description: A sub-circuit extracted from a VCO, consisting of a bias current mirror network (XM1-XM4), voltage level shifters (XM7-XM8), and a parallel amplifier/buffer stage (XM5-XM6). It is likely used to provide stable biasing to suppress flicker noise upconversion in the oscillator core.

paper_reference.title: Suppression of Flicker Noise Upconversion in a 65nm CMOS VCO in the 3.0-to-3.6GHz Band

power_consumption.description: Total DC power consumed by the sub-circuit.

sky130_expected.calculation: With VDD=1.8V, the bias branches and amplifier stage will draw a few mA. Power = VDD * I_total.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Adjusted for SKY130 1.8V supply compared to the 65nm process which likely used 1.0V or 1.2V.

bias_voltage_n4.description: DC bias voltage generated by the diode-connected series pair XM1 and XM2.

sky130_expected.calculation: Voltage divider between VDD (1.8V) and GND formed by identical W/L PMOS and NMOS. V_N4 ≈ VDD/2.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends on the exact Vth and mobility ratio of NMOS vs PMOS in SKY130.

amplifier_dc_gain.description: Low-frequency voltage gain of the XM5/XM6 amplifier stage with a 1kΩ load.

sky130_expected.calculation: gm ≈ 1.25mS. Gain = gm * R_load = 1.25 V/V = 1.9 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated based on standard square-law model for SKY130 NMOS with W/L=10 and 1kΩ load.

sky130_expected.calculation: Pole = 1 / (2 * pi * R_load * C_parasitic). With R=1kΩ and C~10fF, BW ≈ 16GHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Bandwidth is limited by the parasitic drain capacitance of the NMOS devices.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC power, bias voltage, AC gain, and transient response of the extracted VCO sub-circuit.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Testbench for VCO Sub-circuit
.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u

XM1 N4 N4 N3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N4 N4 N5 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 LABEL_NET_0 N4 N3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N4 N4 N5 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 OUT_PLUS N11 N9 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 OUT_PLUS LABEL_NET_2 N9 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 VDD VDD VB1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 VDD VDD LABEL_NET_3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}

* DC Sources
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VLABEL_NET_0 LABEL_NET_0 0 0.9
VVB1 VB1 0 0.75
VLABEL_NET_2 LABEL_NET_2 0 0.9
VLABEL_NET_3 LABEL_NET_3 0 0.9
VN9 N9 0 0
VN3 N3 0 0
VN5 N5 0 1.8

* Input signal for amplifier
VN11 N11 0 0.9 ac 1 sin(0.9 0.1 100Meg)

* Load for amplifier
RL OUT_PLUS VDD 1k

.lib "${SKY130_PDK}/models/sky130.lib.spice" tt

.control
* DC Operating Point
op
let power = -i(VVDD)*1.8
print power
let v_bias = v(N4)
print v_bias

* AC Analysis
ac dec 10 1Meg 100Gig
let gain_db = vdb(OUT_PLUS)
meas ac dc_gain find gain_db at=1Meg
meas ac bw when gain_db='dc_gain-3' fall=1

* Transient Analysis
tran 100p 50n
meas tran vpp_out pp v(OUT_PLUS)

quit
.endc
